purpose: Falsifiable read-only original-source selected-action information-yield detector; never predict outcomes for unselected actions, never steer native policy.

inputs.source_public_schema: exact 7x7x3 public image, source mission literal, integer original heading 0..3; no private pose, map, carrying, oracle, or post-hoc source action remap
inputs.required_outer_episode_digest: Recompute sorted-key compact ASCII JSON SHA256 of entire exact original selected events array before analysis; provided expected SHA is external owner claim and not itself independently authenticated.

classifier.scan: Left-to-right greedy disjoint scan of exact own-selected original action history: prefer 2-step inverse left/right [0,1] or [1,0] if complete view returns to start; else 4 consecutive equal rotations [0,0,0,0] or [1,1,1,1] if complete view returns; else advance one step. Skip consumed actions.
classifier.closure: sha256(exact full public before first action) == sha256(exact full public after final action) with source continuity; not a physical position or world location assertion
classifier.novelty: Episode-initial public before state is already seen; selected actual after-hashes counted new only at their first earlier-in-time occurrence; do not compare to future episodes.
classifier.symbolic_scene: Same MG56 engineered key: exact public mission and sorted multiset of 7x7 pixel triples where type not in (0,1); not physical novelty.
classifier.null_information: A closed cycle containing zero first-time exact public after-hashes, not guaranteed zero useful hidden knowledge or goal value.
classifier.terminal: Terminal or truncated selected step must be last; no duplicate or additional events after episode end.
classifier.evidence: Only existing selected before/action/actual after/reward/terminal events. Do not infer unseen action rewards, reexecute a source, or compare trajectories as matched counterfactual states after divergence.

retrospective_exposed_dev_reference.disposition: EXPOSED_DEV_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY_NO_SCIENCE; source facts already known before this instrument

falsifiers: Reject malformed/hidden public source frame and unadmitted mission string
Reject any step index discontinuity, action outside original 0..6, bool as action, source-external action !=0
Reject before/after original public digest mismatches, even with self-consistent forged episode digest
Reject noncontiguous original public after->next before and changing mission
Reject actor episode exceeding 192 source-selected actions
Reject additional event after true termination or truncation
Reject zero-length episode, malformed reward, NaN and nonbool term flags
Reject fake episode aggregate SHA and missing expected episode digest
Reject exact-view repeated turns if they do not restore the original full before state
Reject 4-turn false positive if action directions do not match
Ensure disjoint cycles counted at most once and cumulative cycle action cost <= source-selected actions
Separate exact-public novelty from rotation-invariant symbolic-scene novelty
Compare independent source-process outputs by exact event and classification identities, never assume process hash from source claim
Run Linux and Windows focused tests plus mandatory full regression for changed N branch before engineering qualification
next_science_gate: Later, with independently verified original-source owner rights, preregister an actual information-yield/goal-evidence exploration intervention and compare to unchanged MG56 OFF, MG47, MG44, fitted model-based/recurrent and native controls on new original DEV. Require sealed unfamiliar-family first-use, real terminal task reward, cold retention and matched CPU/RSS/energy for science.
